decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans 11/AR/HO/P1 submited 27/6/12  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 5 - The building hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 11 Armytage Road, Hounslow.
description: Retention of a detatched outbuilding to the rear garden and demolition of existing garage.
